measurement: C++ steady_clock batches; no Python calls inside native sample loops; NumPy adjacent independent batches

scopes.fused-kernel: prevalidated inputs, preallocated outputs, intermediate finite checks; full recompute
scopes.fused-checked: size/environment checks + exact content scan + changed input finite checks/copies + fused kernel + transactional output commit
scopes.incremental-checked: same input checks/scan + dirty propagation + only changed nodes + transactional buffer swaps
scopes.direct-checked: synchronous borrowed inputs; size/environment + every input/intermediate finite check in arithmetic pass + owned transactional outputs; no change scan/copies
scopes.numpy-reference: preassembled inputs, direct edge or fixed pairwise room operations, allocates outputs

limitations: one host; no render FPS or GPU comparison
startup, protocol parsing and compilation excluded from per-frame kernel times
native output is owned read-only memory until next successful frame; NumPy allocates output
repeat samples average repeated frames; NumPy ratio of medians is not paired; native paired ratio uses rotated batches within each repeat
IR/generation remain offline Python tools; runtime is C++ only
